property_summary: For any caller and any grant parameters, calling newGrantProposal increases the public proposalCount (post-call value > pre-call value); the mutant using proposalCount = proposalCount++ can leave proposalCount unchanged, violating this rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Change increment of proposalCount from pre-increment (proposalCount += 1) to post-increment (proposalCount = proposalCount++) which leaves proposalCount unchanged in Solidity semantics, causing proposalCount to differ after newGrantProposal.
